Counter: page claims 3683 shipments / 39 trading partners / 46 ports; 5 export rows actually visible on the free view (plus 5 import rows from Inver House Distillers, UK).
domestic_evidence: Domestic supply is evidenced indirectly and only partially: the same ImportKey record set shows large-scale inbound raw-material/scotch imports from INVER HOUSE DISTILLERS LTD (Airdrie, Scotland) — "1087 INVER HOUSE DISTILLERS LTD. -> ALLIED BLENDERS AND DISTILLERS LIMITED, TRADING AS: INTERNATIONAL BEVERAGES" — i.e. an operating bottling business with Indian plants (Maliwada ICD INMWA6, Thimmappur ICD INTMX6, Kilaraipur ICD INQRH6 despatch points). No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: company site ablbl.com returned connection errors and the domain ablbl.com resolves to a for-sale parking page; tofler/zaubacorp blocked (403/404). Domestic revenue figures therefore null — not invented.
note: Real, dated export shipments confirmed with B/L numbers, destinations and HS codes: HS 22083013 (blended whisky) to UAE (Sharjah, Ajman) and Haiti (Port-au-Prince), latest 2026-02-28. Declared HS 220820/220830/220840 matches the observed 22083013 — no HS correction needed. Second slug 'allied-blenders-and-distillers-pvt-ltd' (Tumkur Road, Bangalore address) shows only 5 import rows of aseptic carton filling machines from Shandong Bihai Machinery (2018-2022) — that is the same group's plant-level import record, not a separate exporter. Third slug 'allied-blenders-and-distillers-ltd' returned an empty table (0 rows visible). Domestic (India) supply: operating bottling plants and inbound Scotch imports are documented, but no public GST turnover band, tender award or annual-report domestic split was retrievable within the tool budget — domestic_status 'confirmed' rests on the operating-plant/import footprint, and the revenue/domestic-turnover field is null. No sanctions/court/ownership issues assessed here (out of scope for this role).
